chaining: a notebook is not a machine: nothing survives the runtime, so it cannot hold state or serve

reliability_note: Colab states outright that it prioritises interactive users and that runtimes time out when idle, so a long job is cut for reasons that are not visible

free_tier.stated: Colab provides free of charge access to computing resources, including GPUs and TPUs; in the version of Colab that is free of charge notebooks can run for at most 12 hours, depending on availability and your usage patterns; overall usage limits, idle timeout periods, maximum VM lifetime and GPU types vary over time and Colab does not publish these limits.
free_tier.notes: There is no published GPU-hour number. Anything quoted for Colab's free GPU quota is somebody's recollection.

retention.stated: the VM disk is deleted when the runtime is recycled; only Google Drive survives

egress.terms: no published egress allowance or price for the notebook runtime

limits.value: an unpublished, fluctuating usage limit on GPU and total compute

identity_cost.detail: a Google account; no card for the free tier
